sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 700. Success value 100. 4x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 180% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 100% for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 50000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 50000
Lethargy and Frail Resistance Up by 60
